claims.statement: The released forward AES S-box circuit has 29 AND, 97 XOR, 13 XNOR, 139 total gates, gate depth 36, AND-depth 5, profile [9,1,2,2,15], and matches the FIPS 197 S-box on all 256 inputs.
Relative to the pinned NIST 140-gate/depth-37 comparison circuit, the released candidate removes one XNOR gate and one ordinary depth level while preserving the 29-AND count and AND-depth 5.

Within the frozen 24-product outer span and target subspace encoded by frontier_certificate.txt, no 23-product outer realization exists. This is a local exclusion, not a global AES multiplicative-complexity lower bound.
